with TEMP as (SELECT distinct TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD WHERE TRADE_ID =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR TOTLE_TRADE_ID =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all SELECT distinct TOTLE_TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd WHERE TRADE_ID =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR TOTLE_TRADE_ID =#{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union all SELECT #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as TRADE_ID FROM DUAL ) SELECT
, CASE WHEN PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME IS NULL THEN RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE.PTL_BAG_NAME ELSE PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_NAME END PORTFOLIO_NAME, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_NAME ASSET_NAME FROM RSK_ISUP_TRIAL LEFT JOIN RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.IND_ID = RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR.IND_ID LEFT JOIN RSK_ISUP_TRIAL_CLS ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.TRADE_ID = RSK_ISUP_TRIAL_CLS.TRADE_ID AND RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.SEQ_NO=RSK_ISUP_TRIAL_CLS.SEQ_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.PORTFOLIO_ID=PTL_PORTFOLIO.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.PORTFOLIO_ID=RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE.PTL_BAG_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.ASSET_CODE=FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID WHERE RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.TRADE_ID in (select TRADE_ID from TEMP) AND RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.SEQ_NO = ( SELECT max(SEQ_NO) FROM RSK_ISUP_TRIAL WHERE RSK_ISUP_TRIAL.TRADE_ID in (select TRADE_ID from TEMP) )
